svg.aria-label: Pixel-art panorama: the flag of Russia waving on a golden pole across a starry sky with a Su-37 streaking past, while a lone traveler in a Soviet ushanka watches from a rooftop — the dream road below runs Tehran, ITMO Saint Petersburg, KFU Kazan
